name: power-app
description: An in-house, developer-first framework for building internal line-of-business apps with Entra ID SSO. A PowerApps replacement.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @power-app/core build && pnpm --filter @power-app/cli build && pnpm --filter @power-app/web build && pnpm --filter @power-app/server build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @power-app/core build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @power-app/server dev" "pnpm --filter @power-app/web dev"
